# AtomicGeometryToElectronicTopologyMapping

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A framework that translates discrete atomic arrangements into continuous electronic topology signatures (e.g., Fermi surface projections) for ML-based classification. It provides a pathway to link structural topology to functional electronic responses, relevant for designing neuromorphic or topological computing substrates.
